plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for ProSoft Technology wireless device. It reports uptime, interface traffic, and wireless clients/radio, for RadioLinx / RLX2 (enterprise PEN 2382).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: radio_status
metrics.description: RadioLinx / RLX2 radio status integer from enterprise PEN 2382 (1.3.6.1.4.1.2382.1.1.1.0). This is the device-reported radio state scalar; CPU and memory percentages are not synthesized from it.

metrics.name: link_quality_percent
metrics.description: RadioLinx / RLX2 wireless link quality reported directly as a 0-100 percentage from enterprise PEN 2382 (1.3.6.1.4.1.2382.1.1.2.0). Sustained low quality indicates RF interference, antenna issues, or a degrading industrial wireless hop.

metrics.name: signal_strength_dbm
metrics.description: RadioLinx / RLX2 received signal strength in dBm from enterprise PEN 2382 (1.3.6.1.4.1.2382.1.1.3.0), read directly with no scaling. More negative values mean a weaker radio hop and rising risk of packet loss or roam failure.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
